verdict.rationale: The LangSmith SDK/client library is open source on GitHub (langsmith-sdk), giving partial visibility into how traces are sent and instrumented, but the core LangSmith platform itself (tracing backend, dashboards, evaluation engine, alerting) is a closed proprietary SaaS product with no evidence of an open license covering the actual service source. Community comments confirm users must use a hosted/cloud account to see their own traces, underscoring that the core product is not openly readable. missing for 10: open-license source for the core platform/backend, not just the client SDK; explicit license file/repo for LangSmith server itself.
